lines.text: Hi Mei. I've been reading about the four-day week and I'm not sure what to believe.
How many organisations took part in the Meridian pilots you've been studying?
I heard every one of those pilots included a hospital, so it clearly works for shift work.
Saya rasa minggu kerja empat hari terlalu ideal untuk tempat kerja saya.
What happened to burnout and sick days across the pilots?
My manager says I'm the only one on our team who still answers emails on a Sunday.
What did the pilots find about productivity on construction sites?
Unemployment has nothing to do with interest rates, everyone knows that.
Ok lah, but if my company tries it, what should we measure first?
Thanks. What's your favourite counter-example to bring up at dinner?
